raw: {"title":"斜抛与平抛运动：速度能量比较纯物理模型","domain":"projectile","model_js":"globalThis.coursewareModel=Object.freeze({sample(input){const sc=(input&&input.scenario)||{};const times=(input&&input.times_s)||[];const num=(v,d)=>{const n=Number(v);return Number.isFinite(n)?n:d;};const g=num(sc.g_m_s2,9.8);const m=num(sc.mass_kg,1);const v0=num(sc.speed_m_s,0);const x0=num(sc.x0_m,0);const y0=num(sc.y0_m,0);const mode=sc.mode==='horizontal'?'horizontal':'oblique';const deg=mode==='horizontal'?0:num(sc.angle_deg,0);const th=deg*Math.PI/180;const vx0=v0*Math.cos(th);const vy0=v0*Math.sin(th);const ax=0;const ay=-g;const disc=Math.max(0,vy0*vy0+2*g*y0);const tf=g>0?(vy0+Math.sqrt(disc))/g:0;const range=vx0*tf;const tA=vy0>0&&g>0?vy0/g:0;const hMax=y0+(g>0?Math.max(0,vy0*vy0/(2*g)):0);const opt=g>0?Math.atan2(v0,Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,v0*v0+2*g*y0)))*180/Math.PI:(v0>0?45:0);const z=n=>Object.is(n,-0)?0:n;const states=times.map(t0=>{let t=num(t0,0);if(t<0)t=0;if(tf>0&&t>tf)t=tf;const x=x0+vx0*t;const y=Math.max(0,y0+vy0*t-0.5*g*t*t);const vx=vx0;const vy=vy0-g*t;const ke=0.5*m*(vx*vx+vy*vy);const pe=m*g*y;const me=ke+pe;return{t_s:z(t),x_m:z(x),y_m:z(y),vx_m_s:z(vx),vy_m_s:z(vy),ax_m_s2:z(ax),ay_m_s2:z(ay),kinetic_j:z(ke),potential_j:z(pe),mechanical_j:z(me)};});return{states:states,events:{flight_time_s:z(tf),range_m:z(range),apex_time_s:z(tA),max_height_m:z(hMax),optimal_equal_height_angle_deg:z(opt)}};}});"}
